hook.text: Gaining weight for no reason? Exhausted constantly? It might be your thyroid producing too little hormone.

buildup.text: Hypothyroidism slows everything: metabolism, heart rate, and mental sharpness.

climax.text: Thyroid disorders affect 200 million people worldwide.

punchline.text: One gland, two opposite disorders. Both from immune misfires.

quiz.question: What causes Hashimoto's disease?
options: The immune system attacking and destroying thyroid tissue
